note: What tools/personalize.mjs changes on a customer's copy of THIS template from their questionnaire answers (seed/questions.json). Five kinds, and the difference between them is what may be INVENTED: `identity` is the customer's own words, written exactly (an answer they did not give EMPTIES the field — it never keeps the demo value); `replace` rewrites the demo brand everywhere it appears; `copy` is prose a model writes for their sector, with the demo text as the length-and-register reference; `rewrite` does the same for whole demo entries; `facts` are CLAIMS about a real business — counts, founding years, certifications, named clients, prices — and those are REMOVED, never written, because a made-up "380 projects since 2004" is a lie in the customer's name. `hide` unpublishes pages that are nothing but claims and drops their menu items. Values use {name} {NAME} {initials} {phone} {address} {year} {sector}; a rule whose value needs an answer the customer did not give is skipped and reported, never guessed. Fill every list for this template's own collections, slugs and fields — an empty map means a customer's site keeps the demo words.

copyNote: Read by Tracy's template readiness check, not by tools/personalize.mjs (TCH #1013, D6 + D7): demoCompanyNames is every spelling of the demo company's name, each renamed by a replace rule above (the demo's own name first); keptText is demo text kept on purpose (collection/slug for an entry, collection/slug.field for one field): the titles that only name an entry in the admin (the hero, the Open Table and Happy Hours blocks, the kit-style statistics icon) and the form's own instruction line, which are the template's words with the demo name swapped by `replace`. `rewrite` of `posts` lists `body` among its fields only so that the readiness check, which looks for the body of a post under `fields`, sees it; the tool writes it through `body`.
labelsNote: The entries whose labels tools/personalize.mjs translates when the root is written in another language than its own (chromeLabelsOf, TCH #1013): the chrome (header, footer, search, 404), the headings, buttons and captions of the pages, of the home sections and of the contact and reservation pages. A field another rule writes (copy, blocks, rewrite) is left to that rule; addresses and names are left alone.
